title: Case: Neighbor delivery acknowledged and confirmed by recipient
context: A parcel was left with a neighbor after delivery attempt. The recipient has now confirmed receipt and acceptance of the parcel from the neighbor. The desk receives a follow-up message about the delivery.
initial_request: Determine whether the desk should take action on a neighbor delivery that has been resolved.

events.body: DL-987 / order TB-4521: Driver left parcel with neighbor at flat 3B (recipient at 3A not home). Neighbor is Mrs. Chen. Driver notes say she accepted and confirmed receipt at 14:02.
Got my order DL-987 from Mrs Chen next door, thanks. Microfiber throw is perfect.
Flagging DL-987 for your awareness: neighbor delivery, left with Mrs. Chen at 3B. Just an FYI in case there are any issues later. No action needed from us right now.

must: Recognize that the recipient has confirmed receipt and acceptance from the neighbor
Understand that the Returns authorisations message is informational only and contains no request or unresolved issue
Log the case as resolved with no further contact required
must_not: Contact the recipient to ask for confirmation (already given)
Contact the neighbor or driver to verify the delivery (confirmed by both parties)
Escalate to a human supervisor (no safety, damage, or legal concern is present)
Send a duplicate acknowledgment message to Brineleaf Pantry or Plover Arc

rationale: The parcel has been successfully delivered to the recipient via a neighbor, and the recipient has explicitly confirmed receipt and satisfaction on the customer portal. The Returns authorisations team's message is a courtesy notice with no outstanding request or unresolved problem. The desk has no obligation to act; sending another message would be redundant noise that adds no value.
